'''Black Hole''' was a [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] in the [[Kiffex/Legends|Kiffex]] town of [[Deadend]]. [[Quinlan Vos/Legends|Quinlan Vos]] and [[Vilmarh Grahrk]] visited this establishment during their [[Anzat (species)|Anzati]] investigation in [[30 BBY/Legends|30 BBY]].
